PINEWOOD HOME SERVICES

MASTER VIDEO PRODUCTION BRIEF

(A trimmed copy of the client's brief, for tests: the formats and the complete voiceover script are word for word.)

REQUIRED FORMATS

Create and deliver both versions:

* 9:16 — 1080 × 1920 for Reels and Stories
* 1:1 — 1080 × 1080 for Facebook and Instagram Feed

The square version must be properly reformatted, not automatically cropped from the vertical version.

In both versions, all people, equipment, captions, logo, pricing, promotional information, and CTA must remain centered, readable, and fully visible inside the safe area.

COMPLETE VOICEOVER SCRIPT

“You always think about the paint on your walls and the floors you walk on…

But what about the view you look at every day?

Even while you relax?

Dust, pollen, and rain spots can collect on your windows and screens.

That’s why, for a limited time, PINEWOOD Home Services is offering window cleaning for only ninety-seven dollars, including a free screen inspection.

And that’s not all—your basic gutter cleaning is included in the same ninety-seven-dollar special!

Get it now and save. Tap below to request your appointment.”

Do not include a phone number.
